title: First-year company compliance
description: A starter checklist for a newly incorporated Nigerian private company. Confirm the details with a qualified lawyer or company secretary.

items.text: Confirm that the company was registered for a lawful purpose and retain its incorporation records.
Set up accounting records for receipts, payments, assets, and liabilities.
Identify the annual-return form, attachments, signatories, and deadline that apply to the company.
